description.value:
A studded breastplate over a gambeson, with shoulder pauldrons that fit at least three different body types badly. Worn by Domain patrols, hex constables, and anyone who needs to look like they have authority without carrying signature gear. Cheap, repairable, and forgivingly average.

No signature, no harmonization, no questions asked at the gate.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Medium
  • Defense: Guard +3
  • Requires: Bracing (trained)
  • Tier: II
  • Cost: 225 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Inlaid (+1). Hex-inlay along the working edge.

  • +1 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +3 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier II · free to wield.

item.signature: Issued, dented, returned, reissued. Honest metal.
